check: Validity of dates, LOS, GRD, weight, severity and age; exact duplicate rows (2,927.0 = 0.14%)
result and decision: No negative LOS; 52 unparseable admission dates and 47 unknown GRD codes excluded; duplicates retained because, without an episode or patient ID, identical rows can be distinct episodes

check: Schema and category sets 2023 vs 2024; stability of LOS definition
result and decision: Different encoding and date format per year handled at parsing; the same IR-GRD 3.0 grouper column and identical category sets for discharge, admission and activity type; 4 hospitals added in 2024, so year comparisons use the 68 common hospitals

check: Hospital code against FONASA dictionary and MINSAL facilities; GRD and severity codes against the IR-GRD dictionary
result and decision: 72/72 hospital codes match MINSAL facilities and 71/72 match FONASA's dictionary (200717, new in 2024, is missing there); m:1 join, rows unchanged; GRD last digit = severity in 99.85% of episodes; facilities file is the current version

check: Extraction dates and lag to the decision
result and decision: FONASA extracted 2023 on 04-09-2024 and 2024 on 16-05-2025; latest discharge 31-12-2024. Suitable for an annual review of benchmarks, not for day-to-day bed management; each file is a snapshot, later coding corrections are not reflected

check: Coverage of population, periods, fields and exceptions
result and decision: Covers inpatient discharges of GRD-funded public hospitals only (68-72), not lower-complexity or private hospitals; stays open at year end are not observed; no bed-waiting time, social cause of delay, ICU days or cost; no patient ID, so readmissions cannot be linked
